## Wakt 1.0.9

### Onboarding
A first-run intro with illustrations: what Wakt does, no account and no tracking, free and open source. Then each permission on its own page with a live "Granted / Not yet" status, a Grant button that opens the right system screen, and a plain-language "Why" for every one: Usage Access, Display over other apps, battery optimization, and the optional Accessibility Service with the banking-app warning. Every step can be skipped and finished later from Settings, where "Show the intro and permission setup again" replays it.

### Daily goals with streaks, on your wallpaper
A new Goals tab. Add a promise such as "No reels", then answer once a day: "I kept it" or "I slipped". Each goal shows its current streak, best streak, and total days kept.

Turn on "Show streaks on wallpaper" and Wakt paints "Day N" for each goal onto your lock screen, home screen, or both, and repaints it just after midnight. If a day goes unanswered the wallpaper says so. You see your number every time you pick up the phone, without opening the app. Nothing is sent anywhere; the image is drawn on the device.
